mapper.select: SELECT i.*, w.node_name as warehouse_name, m.material_name, b.batch_no FROM spd_inventory i LEFT JOIN spd_org_node w ON i.warehouse_id = w.node_id AND w.del_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN spd_material m ON i.material_id = m.material_id AND m.del_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN spd_material_batch b ON i.batch_id = b.batch_id AND b.del_flag = 0 WHERE i.id = #{id} AND i.del_flag = 0
